description: This file contains UI smoke tests for the OnboardingView in a SwiftUI application, verifying the view's construction, page flow logic, and remote gateway selection behavior.

classes.name: OnboardingViewSmokeTests
classes.description: A test suite containing multiple smoke tests for the OnboardingView component, verifying UI construction, logic flow, and state changes.

methods.name: `onboarding view builds body`
methods.description: Verifies that the OnboardingView's body property can be constructed without issues.

methods.name: `page order omits workspace and identity steps`
methods.description: Checks that certain steps are omitted from the onboarding page order based on the conditions.

methods.name: `page order omits onboarding chat when identity known`
methods.description: Ensures the onboarding chat step is not included when identity information is available.

methods.name: `select remote gateway clears stale ssh target when endpoint unresolved`
methods.description: Simulates selecting a remote gateway and verifies that the remote target is cleared if the endpoint is unresolved, using environment variable manipulation and async testing.
